source_text:
14.5 Τὸ
ἀργύριον αὐτοῦ οὐκ ε δωκεν τόκῳ.
Τοῦτο λεκτέον πρὸς τοὺς τοκιστὰς, ὡς
κωλυτικὸν τῆς ἐν ἁγίῳ ο ρει κατασκηνώσεως. ̔Ο ποιῶν ταῦτα, οὐ σαλευθήσεται εἰς
τὸν αἰῶνα.
Εὐσεβίου. Ο γε μὴν ὁμοῦ πάντα προκα τηριθμημένα κατορθώσας,
ἀντιτελὴς γενό μενος, καὶ πᾶν τὸ σῶμα τῆς κατὰ Θεὸν πο λιτείας ὁλόκληρον, ω σπερ
καὶ ὑγιὲς καὶ πᾶσιν ἀγαθοῖς λόγων τε καὶ ε ργων ἀπηρτισ μένον διατηρήσας, οὐ
σαλευθήσεται εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα.
pass_a_gloss: The silver of-him not he-gave to-interest. This is-to-be-said toward the interest-lenders, as preventative of the in holy mountain tabernacling. The doing these-things, not will-be-shaken into the age. Of-Eusebius. The-one at-any-rate together all previously-enumerated having-succeeded, complete having-become, and all the body of-the according-to God way-of-life intact, as-also both healthy and with-all good-things of-words and of-deeds completed having-preserved, not will-be-shaken into the age.
pass_b_english: “His silver he did not give on interest” (Psalm 14:5).
This is to be said to the usurers, as something that prevents tabernacling on the holy mountain. “The one who does these things will not be shaken forever.”

Eusebius: The one who has succeeded in all the things previously enumerated together, having become complete, and having kept the whole body of the way of life according to God intact — as also healthy and finished with all good things of words and of deeds — will not be shaken forever.

choices.english: he did not give on interest
choices.why: Psalm 14:5a. τόκος is interest on a loan. Not ‘he did not give his money at all’.
rejected: he did not give his money
he did not give usury as a gift

choices.why: Psalm 14:1. OCR ο ρει is ὄρει, not an uncertain ὁρεῖ/ὁρᾶς.

choices.term: Ὁ ποιῶν ταῦτα, οὐ σαλευθήσεται εἰς τὸν αἰῶνα
choices.english: The one who does these things will not be shaken forever
choices.why: Psalm 14:5b. ταῦτα is plural: the listed deeds, not one act of not-lending.
rejected: the one who does this will not be shaken into the age

choices.english: having succeeded in all the things previously enumerated
choices.why: OCR προκα τηριθμημένα. The holy-mountain list of 14:2–5, not ‘carefully’.
rejected: having accomplished all things together carefully

choices.why: Printed ἀντιτελής kept; not ‘becoming opposite’ from ἀντί. Unrestored as αὐτοτελής/ἐντελής.

choices.english: the way of life according to God
choices.why: πολιτεία is the whole conduct, not ‘divine worship’ as cult only.
rejected: the city’s politics according to God

anf_compare.notes: ANF lacks this Greek catena as reading English.
